verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that LangSmith can be hosted in your own infrastructure, covering observability, evaluation, and prompt engineering, with optional LangSmith Deployment. Helm configuration guidance for self-hosted Agent Server load tuning backs this up. Community posts (one user wanting an easy local version, another saying a cloud account is needed to see traces) suggest self-hosting is not readily accessible to every user, but they do not concretely show the documented self-hosted option failing. Missing for 10: installation and requirements detail, licensing or plan availability for self-hosting, independent or hands-on confirmation of a working self-hosted deployment.
